[[File:Wreckage_Excavation_Vehicle.png|thumb|A WEV transporting the [[Force Harvester]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].]]

The '''Wreckage Excavation Vehicle (WEV)''' is a large, floating<ref name="CWG">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> [[Repulsor barge|repulsorlift barge]]<ref name="FF107">{{FactFile|107|SUR 3-6|The Survival of Boba Fett}}</ref> equipped with heavy-duty [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]]. It is designed to move heavy cargo from one point to another and is very slow.<ref name="CWG" />

During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Conquest of Raxus Prime|conquest]] of the junk [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], one such vehicle was in the service of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], assisting in transporting a recently unearthed [[Force Harvester|object]] of ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] creation aboard a [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|transport]].<ref name="CW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>
